answer.question: Which industries does TEAM International serve?
answer.text: TEAM International is an enterprise software development company serving technology, media and telecommunications; healthcare and wellness; finance and banking; travel and hospitality; retail and distribution; logistics and transportation; business services; engineering staffing; and oil and gas. Each industry has a team that knows its systems, regulations and data. Senior teams in Medellín serve North America and in Ukraine serve Europe, from ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified locations.

items.q: Which industries we serve have their own teams?
items.a: TEAM International has dedicated teams and pages for technology, media and telecommunications; healthcare and wellness; finance and banking; travel and hospitality; retail and distribution; logistics and transportation; business services; and engineering staffing. Oil and gas has its own site, Oil and Gas Digital Solutions.

items.q: What does an enterprise software development company do?
items.a: An enterprise software development company designs, builds, integrates and runs the software a business depends on: core platforms, customer apps, integrations and data pipelines. TEAM delivers enterprise software development solutions end to end, from discovery to production support, with its own engineers rather than subcontractors.

items.q: How are industry solutions different from generic software development?
items.a: Industry specific solutions start from the systems, data and regulations of your sector, such as EHRs and HIPAA in healthcare, GDS in travel or EDI in logistics. That means less time explaining your business and fewer surprises in production. Industry specific software also reuses patterns proven with other clients in the same sector.

items.q: How should we compare enterprise software development companies?
items.a: Whether you are looking at an enterprise software development agency or a larger enterprise software development firm, check four things: delivered work in your industry, a small and fixed first phase, the ability to run what they build, and security credentials such as ISO 27001. Also ask who will work on your project and in which time zone.

items.q: What does the enterprise software development process look like?
items.a: TEAM's process has three steps: discover your systems and goals, build in short phases with working software at the end of each one, and then run and improve the result under agreed SLAs. You decide whether to continue after every phase.

items.q: Do you only work with large enterprises?
items.a: No. TEAM brings more than 20 years of enterprise level software development to mid-size companies too. Software development for enterprises and for growing mid-size companies follows the same practices; only the scope of the first phase changes.

items.q: Where are your enterprise software developers based?
items.a: Our engineers serve North America from Medellín and Europe from Ukraine, so they work in your language and time zone. All locations are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.

items.q: What if my industry is not listed?
items.a: We group IT solutions by industry to show relevant work, but most of what we build carries across sectors. Tell us about your systems and goals, and an expert will show you comparable projects and a first step.
